item.title: TN Assembly elections: DMDK gets 10 seats, VCK 8 in seat-sharing deal with DMK
item.description: Apart from allocating 8 seats to the VCK, the DMK has given 28 seats to the Congress, 5 each to CPI and CPI M, 2 each to IUML, KMDK and MMK, and 4 seats to the MDMK led by Vaiko.

item.title: Aaj Ki Baat: Full episode, March 24, 2026
item.description: Trump claimed that the Iranian side contacted him to broker a truce in the Middle East, claiming they wanted to make a deal with the US. Tehran, however, refuted his claim.

item.title: 3 players who can replace Ben Duckett in Delhi Capitals squad for IPL 2026
item.description: Delhi Capitals opener Ben Duckett has pulled out of the IPL 2026. He was bought for INR 2 crore in the auction. However, to focus on his international cricket, Duckett opted out. Delhi are now in search for a possible replacement and here are three cricketers they are likely to target.

item.title: 'India to play key role in ensuring favourable balance of power in Indo-Pacific,' says US official
item.description: During his two-day visit to the Indian capital, the US official pointed to ongoing geopolitical tensions, including the situation in West Asia and increasing military activity in the Indo-Pacific, as factors making closer cooperation between the two countries more important than ever.

item.title: Cardiovascular surgeon warns smoking raises fracture risk, makes bones ‘weaker and more fragile
item.description: While smoking is often linked to lung and heart diseases, it also weakens bones by reducing bone density. Dr Jeremy London explains how smoking increases fracture risk and affects calcium absorption, but adds that quitting can help reverse the damage over time.

item.title: Kamal Haasan says his party MNM will not contest Tamil Nadu election, announces support to DMK
item.description: Haasan, who currently serves as a Member of Parliament in the Rajya Sabha, entered the Upper House unopposed on June 12 with the backing of the DMK alliance. His growing alignment with the ruling party has been evident over recent years.

item.title: US B-52 Stratofortress bomber issues distress call over UK airspace: Was an Iranian missile the reason?
item.description: A B-52H Stratofortress made a mid-air distress call over the United Kingdom and returned safely to RAF Fairford, with the cause still unknown.

item.title: If MS Dhoni plays as an Impact Player in IPL 2026, it
item.description: Aakash Chopra feels MS Dhoni should retire if he plays as an Impact Player in IPL 2026, stressing his value lies on the field. With CSK backing youth and Sanju Samson as a successor, signs point to a potential final season for the veteran.

item.title: Mangal-Budh Yuti 2026: Mars-Mercury conjunction in Pisces to boost career and money for these 3 zodiac signs
item.description: Mars and Mercury will form a conjunction in Pisces in April 2026, a phase linked with sharper thinking and action. This alignment may bring positive changes in career and finances for some zodiac signs, including Taurus, Gemini and Sagittarius.

item.title: 'Will Paralyse and drown you in the Gulf': Iran's top military adviser issues stark warning to US
item.description: Mohsen Rezaei, Iran's new military adviser and former IRGC commander, issued a stark warning to the United States, saying Iran could “paralyse” Washington and “sink” its ships in the Arabian Gulf if attacked.
